meta.name: firebase-test-lab-migration-skill
meta.description: Migrate test automation from Firebase Test Lab to TestMu AI (formerly LambdaTest) in any language or framework. Covers gcloud firebase test android|ios run (instrumentation, XCTest, Robo, Game Loop), device model and API-level strings, Fastlane/Bitrise/Codemagic/GitHub Actions wrappers; Test Lab is deprecated with shutdown on 30 September 2027. Use this whenever someone wants to move, switch, port, migrate or point tests from Firebase Test Lab to TestMu AI or LambdaTest, asks what the TestMu or LT:Options equivalent is for a capability, config, CLI flag or API from Firebase Test Lab, mentions gcloud firebase test, --type instrumentation, --type robo, --device model=, run_tests_firebase_testlab and firebase_test_lab_ios_xctest fastlane actions, test lab in CI YAML, Firebase Test Lab shutdown, or wants a migration plan, estimate, PR or checklist for a repo currently on Firebase Test Lab, even without the word migrate.
